title: How to Cancel GitHub Copilot — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel GitHub Copilot subscription in 60 seconds. Stop the $10/mo charge and use the free tier. Steps for Individual and Business plans.
intro: GitHub Copilot Individual can be canceled directly from your GitHub settings. The free tier now includes limited completions, so you don't lose AI assistance entirely.

steps.title: Go to GitHub Copilot settings
steps.text: Visit github.com/settings/copilot while signed in to your GitHub account. Or: click your avatar → Settings → Copilot.

steps.title: Click "Cancel" or "Manage subscription"
steps.text: In the Copilot settings page, find your subscription details and click "Cancel" or navigate to the billing section.
steps.tip: If Copilot was provided by your organization, you cannot cancel it yourself — contact your org admin.

steps.title: Confirm cancellation
steps.text: Select a reason for canceling and confirm. Your Copilot access continues until the end of your current billing period.
steps.tip: GitHub Copilot Free gives you limited completions per month — it may be enough if you're not coding full-time.

warnings: If Copilot is provided through a GitHub Organization or Enterprise plan, only an admin can remove your seat.
GitHub Copilot Free still offers limited AI completions — you don't lose all AI assistance.
Your code suggestions history and settings are preserved if you re-subscribe.
Student/teacher accounts get Copilot free through GitHub Education — check eligibility before paying.

faqs.q: Is GitHub Copilot free for students?
faqs.a: Yes. Verified students and teachers get GitHub Copilot free through GitHub Education (education.github.com). If you're eligible, you don't need a paid subscription.

faqs.q: What's the difference between Copilot Free and Pro?
faqs.a: Free gives you limited completions per month. Pro ($10/mo) gives unlimited completions, chat, and access to multiple models. Business ($19/mo) adds org management and policy controls.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund for GitHub Copilot?
faqs.a: GitHub handles refunds on a case-by-case basis. Contact GitHub support through their help portal for refund requests.

faqs.q: What are good free alternatives to GitHub Copilot?
faqs.a: Codeium (free AI completions), Cody by Sourcegraph (free tier), and Amazon CodeWhisperer (free for individual use) are solid alternatives.

refund.details: Contact GitHub support for refund requests. They handle these case-by-case. No automatic refunds for unused portions.

retentionTactics: GitHub doesn't use aggressive retention tactics for Copilot. Cancellation is clean.
